debug.description: Enable verbose debugging to stderr and syslog. Only for troubleshooting.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Increase under heavy load.

keytab.description: Absolute path to the Kerberos keytab file for service ticket decryption.

socket_path.description: Absolute path to the Unix domain socket used for client communication.

persistent_cache.description: If true, persist credentials cache across system reboots (requires filesystem persistence).

max_ticket_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime (in seconds) of cached tickets (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours).

max_renew_lifetime.description: Maximum renew lifetime (in seconds) of tickets before re-authentication required.

enctypes.description: Ordered list of acceptable encryption types (e.g., aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96, aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96). Leave empty to use defaults.

allowed_groups.description: Unix group names allowed to access the KCM socket. Leave empty for root-only access.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility used for logging (typically 'auth' or 'authpriv').

windows_referrals.description: Enable experimental support for Windows KDC referrals (may be unstable).

referrals.description: Static realm referral mappings. Each entry defines a trusted external realm and its KDC.

realm.description: Name of the external Kerberos realm (e.g., EXAMPLE.COM).

kdc.description: Hostname or IP of the KDC for the external realm.
